cp1Answer: For a parcel that HAS a baked snapshot and whose facets say status "ok" (Pflugerville 48453:427599) the drawn polygon comes from the LIVE place/buildable-envelope (labelEdges+derive) POST, never from the atom's geojson -- the atom carries no geometry at all -- BUT the baked facets decide whether that live derive is allowed to run: facetsNeedLiveEnvelopeDerive (hauska-map apps/property-explorer/src/lib/live-envelope-augment.ts:69-81) requires envelope.status === "ok" plus real setback scalars, and the card drives it at src/lib/fact-sheet-resolver.ts:2745-2762 with the envelope built from the AUGMENTED facets at :2771. The integration seat's reading of the header is therefore REFUTED in its strong form (the facets do not supply the polygon) and CONFIRMED in its weak form (for a baked parcel the facets decide whether a polygon is ever drawn). Consequence, and it is why both repos were needed: the hauska-map branch is the real fix for the DRAWING (the old status:"declined" branch never let the derive fire), while the LDT change is necessary for the FIGURE and the served outcomes but not sufficient for the polygon.

2026-09-16: on the serving side the buildable-envelope atom's outcome is read in exactly ONE place (LDT composeBuildableEnvelopeDerivation.ts:135-144 into reconcileAtomEnvelope.ts), so MCP, the card and the route cannot disagree about the atom's figure -- 'the MCP payload' (dispatch item 3) is not a separate surface to edit.

A paired-control fixture must carry the NEGATIVE-SPACE cases around the predicate, not only the obvious ones. The first version of this fixture declared the marker, the citation, the reason and 'no atom', and a whitespace-tolerant edit to the predicate SURVIVED it (found by running falsifier 5 instead of asserting it). Adding padded-marker-not-promoted and citation-case-variant-not-promoted made that edit fail. When a predicate is exact-match, the fixture needs a near-miss and a padded variant or it is not testing exactness.

Declare both answers per fixture case. A fixture that only says 'verified: false' cannot catch a reason predicate that is too loose or too tight; carrying machineVerifyDiagnostic alongside verified is what makes the two legs independent.

Do not put the fix in the client's fallback path. hauska-map's InspectCard header still reads as 'baked first, live fallback', but since P-39/I2 the card issues NO lookup of its own: it resolves one sealed sheet (InspectCard.tsx:912-972). Reasoning from that header (as the integration seat did) leads to the wrong file; the preference that matters is facetsNeedLiveEnvelopeDerive inside the sheet resolver.

Do not expect the local legacy-design-tools full suite to be green: depthRailGateDivergence.test.ts, txgioSitusSearchBudget.test.ts and DATABASE_URL-dependent suites fail in a laptop clone with or without these changes, while CI's Test job (which has the postgres/postgis service) passed in 12m10s.
